newsitem.title: USA: CP&L Robinson 2 nuke up after trip - NRC.
newsitem.headline: CP&L Robinson 2 nuke up after trip - NRC.

text.p: Carolina Power & Light Co's (CP&L) 683 megawatt (MW) Robinson 2 nuclear power unit was in startup mode after a brief automatic trip Sunday, according to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC).
The reactor was shut from 20 percent power due to a valve failure. The company planned "to place the unit on line today," the NRC said Monday in its daily status report.
The Hartsville, S.C., unit was returning to service from a refueling and maintenance outage that began September 7.
CP&L officials could not be reached for comment.
